notes.title: UFO update
notes.notes:
Hey Revivers,

The new UFO update raids the Prologue and the Full game! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/1219d7c6f75469576abac48036c610a62f4e0187.jpg

Martian masters are here to steal the last cow on Earth and to demand ransom! 
They also place Martian Monoliths all over the place to spread their native fauna and flora.

You can choose to obey and share the resources to make a good relationships for trading. Or you can choose to disobey.

[previewyoutube=Gw-s9kpesBk;full][/previewyoutube]

The Prologue will introduce you to the story briefly, showing you new Martian buildings in polished tutorial map. 
The full game now offers a new Concrete Age and the start of the Space Age, in which you can build a spaceship and prepare to go into space, face the Martians and save the cow.

The enemies are optional and if you prefer chill gameplay, you can switch them off.

Patch notes for the new version 0.14.13:


 Polished and shortened Prologue
 Added UFO into the Prologue
 Added Martian Monolith into the Prologue
 Rebalanced the cleaning of toxins by water
 Fixed the unusual appearance of toxins
 Added new particles for spawning monsters and turrets
 Characters no longer get stuck while transporting resources
 Dead plants turning into biomass are now a resource and don’t need to be harvested
 Fixed the issue of infinite tree cutting
 Fixed trees remaining on the ground after being cut
 Improved monsters' navigation
 Fixed unrepairable buildings



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/b7291db0a59a2ed9a50aee9c97d4cbaf02bf042f.jpg

Enjoy the new spiced gameplay!

notes.title: Update 2 - GOLEMS
notes.notes:
Update 2 - GOLEMS is OUT!

A massive update for Revive & Prosper is here, making your gameplay even smoother and more efficient! 


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/1cf8b886c9f6a2771534e0d28bfe0322d59286bc.gif

Here's what's new:

Introducing 3 New Golems:

Stone Golem: With a 72-hour lifespan, this golem excels underwater and boasts the highest bonuses for planting and harvesting. Spawn it using stone and wood.

Metal Golem: A true beast with a shiny look but a heavy metal heart inside and a 120-hour lifespan. Crafted from iron ingots and coal, it offers unmatched strength.

High-Tech Golem: The pinnacle of golem technology, with a 144-hour lifespan. It works underwater and carries loads of resources, representing the height of efficiency and capability.
For a deeper dive into the golem updates, check out our pre-release post: Revive & Prosper Golem Update.

Check out the beautifiul resources you'll be gathering for creating your side-kicks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/a82cf13d24fe907aa53dd768150212e94479ffa5.jpg

One-Click Belt Upgrades!
Upgrading your belts is now as simple as a click. Upgrade individual belts or entire lines effortlessly,  just click on the wooden belt and then on the Upgrade button in the right window. 
To upgrade a whole line, simply select metal belts in the build menu and then mark the line of wooden belts with the selected metal belts. And your characters will do the rest.

Gameplay Enhancements:


 Golems and mutants can now level up their skills, supercharging their efficiency in harvesting, digging, and building. Get ready to expand your bases faster than ever!
 To keep your golems at peak performance, recharge them in the new Golem Recharger building. Just keep an eye on your biomass supply!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/e6307740affffc94cc2bde47c22e1838d662d617.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/3549c159a6d902a4026a2a9b3e2f2f2febb26b2e.gif

Balancing & Fixes:


 Resources from the lowest levels and limestone have been rebalanced for a smoother gameplay experience.
 Chemical plants now require a maximum of 2 liquids for production, streamlining your manufacturing processes.
 The beloved blue sky has returned, enhancing the cozy and neat atmosphere of Revive & Prosper's world.
 Tutorial improvements to eliminate common errors.
 Fixes for building dams and ensuring electric power nets connect properly.
 Resolved issues with fertilizers becoming toxic, teleporters causing crashes, natural tree spreading, and game crashes related to job assignments.


And now, hurry to build an epic base!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/c2951da23c971fa67e69376d360e0be7cd913056.gif

Team Revive & Prosper wishes you happy gaming! 🌱

notes.title: Massive Prologue Update v 0.10.31 is Here!
notes.notes:
Hey Reviers!

In this update you'll find out what has been fixed, what has been improved, and which new objects you will unlock after finishing the Prologue map.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/3dfa598883bfdc2b0977384deec35bdcf7f9efb0.png

Patch notes

 Multiple improvements to the tutorial
 Fixed problems with fragmented ground after a meteor landed
 Resolved issues with characters walking through the floor on slopes
 Fixed problems related to repairing the golem factory and the fishing spot
 Enhanced UI for selecting a filter
 Improved handling of situations where one character has no path to any job
 Missing Handyman Workshop for Electronic components and Solar panels is back
 New Features: Revised Iron Age - Unlock Additional Structures
 In the restructured Iron Age, experience the unlocking of additional buildings upon creating iron. Metal Mechanism now requires iron instead of steel, while Metal Sheet demands steel instead of iron.
 New Steel Mining Machine: Dig Faster and Reach 9 Fields Below
 Introducing the cutting-edge Steel Mining Machine, designed for accelerated excavation. Dig down to a depth of 9 fields, enhancing resource extraction efficiency.
 Enhanced Iron Storage: Double the Capacity of Wooden Storage
 Upgrade your storage capabilities with the new Iron Storage facility, doubling the capacity of conventional wooden storage during the Iron Age.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/c344298afd71dbd729334dc2867c696c135e7128.png

Release notes

 Minor updates to enhance the tutorial experience.
 Fixes and Improvements:
 Several minor fixes to improve overall stability and address minor issues.
 New Features and Fixes in Additional Update:
 New factory: Incinerator for massive destruction of anything, such as toxic soil or unwanted clay
 Second driller added to enhance efficiency
 Golems are now shown below the character who spawned them
 New icons in the build menu for improved aesthetics and orientation
 Added "soft lock" on buildings to indicate that required resources are not in production
 UI now displays new buildings unlocked by producing new resources
 Added Incinerator in the Electric Age
 Added Deep Spiral Digger
 Lightconductor rebalanced with added particles indicating which conductor was hit


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/a4cff95908797b65af64bab3f6262978442f2991.gif

Thank you for your continued support and enjoy the updated version of the game!

notes.title: Meteor drops with new Update!
notes.notes:
Hey Revivers🌱

In a last-minute twist, we're introducing this spectacular celestial event that promises to shake up your gameplay. 

Available in the Closed beta, Demo, and Prologue now!🔥 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/32bc52e513746fb17f9a4573348a6f0d9c7f72c7.gif

Here's the inside scoop on the meteor:


 Brace for impact as the meteor hurtles towards the surface, leaving in its wake a mesmerizing crater filled with extraordinary resources. Explore the aftermath to discover unique and valuable materials that will elevate your survival game to new heights.

 The meteor's arrival is not just a visual spectacle; it's a force to be reckoned with. Watch in awe as it ignites a fiery blaze, consuming nearby trees and crops. Adapt and strategize as you navigate the aftermath, turning adversity into opportunity.

 Craft the destiny for you and other players by strategically placing meteors on your custom-designed maps in the game editor. Shape the landscape and challenge your survival skills by orchestrating meteor showers that will test even the most seasoned Revivers.


Get ready for an unprecedented level of excitement as the meteor crashes into your world, leaving behind a trail of challenges and rewards. 

This is not just an update; it's a cosmic game-changer that will redefine your survival journey. Embrace the chaos, Revivers, and let the meteoric mayhem begin! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/ab975944ca6e85c3ddc268054c06a15f79b22a13.png

In case you enjoy simple and efficient factory building with automation, just choose the Builder difficulty with no danger.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/f76eec9dfbfae0d96d0aad57ff88dc9c51567f1a.png

Available in the Closed beta, Demo, and Prologue now!

Best regards,

~Mystiqular Team

notes.title: Early Access & user experience update
notes.notes:
Hello Revivers,
in today's update, you'll find:


 A brand new explanatory video from the game's creator PJ Strnad
 Early Access release date
 Release notes on the most important improvements focusing on a better game experience
 Patch notes about the most crucial game fixe


[previewyoutube=Eo3jlSvdT2E;full][/previewyoutube]

We're elated to announce that the early access release date is December 5th, 2023 on Steam.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/8fd33da731e063fcc323239e2a203b0d61d4b0aa.png

Release Notes:

 The first tutorial map has been refined with new tooltips and map improvements to provide you with clearer guidance on map objectives. These improvements ensure a smoother entry into the game.
 Navigating your industrious mutants and golems just got easier. Use the navigation button in the info panel to check if your mutants can reach their desired destination before sending them on their way.
 The bottom menu now features the all-new Priority Button, a game-changer for job prioritization.
 We've balanced construction times for buildings, ensuring a more efficient experience.
 Windmills now display a production curve throughout the day, giving you better insights into their power generation.
 Manage your power network more easily with a visual representation of connected factories in a light green color. Just click the "Show Power Line" button in the right info panel.
 Build dams and platforms within sloped terrain.
 Power slots are now visible after selecting an element from the building menu and inserting a torque rod.
 Enjoy the serene sounds of birds chirping, as you build your industrial empire.


Patch Notes:

 We've resolved the issue causing the game to crash after setting catapults.
 Water now flows as intended.
 The "You won" sign will now only appear once on maps where you continue playing after achieving victory.
 The Digging Wheel keeps digging without breaks.
 The Blacksmith's misplaced warning about missing steel has been corrected.
 Poplars are now successfully planting their seeds.
 Ground digging will no longer destroy pipes hidden within.
 We've polished the visual effects of the Coal Plant's smoke.
 Stone resources have been refined.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/1f1d7e218b43a900694f4430f182a71a93971f24.png

Wishlist the FULL game, please, it will mean the world to us.
►►►Revive & Prosper FULL GAME◄◄◄

If the game is already on your wishlist, consider joining our Discord.
Revive & Prosper Discord

Thank you and happy reviving!
-team

notes.title: Major update August 2023 - 0.7.37
notes.notes:
This version have major update on the terrain. We added the slopes which completely changes the face of the game. They are also walkable so overall game play is now more fluent as you don't need to build stairs every time you want to go somewhere.

Upgraded overall visual and lightning to better distinguish day & night and tuned visuals for rain, sand storm and heat.

Released first building on electricity:
- electric poles
- electric wind mill
- electric generator which can convert electricity to torque and back

Multiple small bugs and tweaks handled meanwhile.

notes.title: Prologue Update
notes.notes:
Hey, Revivers🌱

We’re super thrilled to announce that we have added loads of new and free content to the Prologue!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/52858120a53cb991ed120dcf54c414ac10cafa1a.png

The game map is playable beyond the completion of the Prologue! 

What does this mean to you? It means that from now on you have complete access to the advanced building menu. You will be able to build & upgrade your base as much as possible.

[previewyoutube=e1qzFcO46I8;full][/previewyoutube]

Remember, this is an ever-changing environment, and H20 is key for everything. Store them well by building nice dams.

Food is fuel for your characters, and also serves as a resource for Biomass production. Use Biomass for recharging Golems!

[previewyoutube=HvblVuK_EZ8;full][/previewyoutube]

So what are you waiting for? Take control of your crew of animals and their golem friends. Revive the lands and prosper using the latest technology. 🪴🫵💪🏻 

Thank you so much for your support! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44361605/db5371902ea2e5cd35b3d386bca0735c732cd254.png

We wouldn’t have made it this far without your constant feedback and support. Please drop us your amazing insight related to our latest update in our feedback channel - https://discord.gg/9HUX3vvcpX

Also… we really want to see the base you have built so far, please don’t hesitate to share the same with us in our discord server - https://discord.gg/aJgVanMmt5

Thank you once again!
